channel.title: Our Hakhamim — Dayan Daniel Kada
channel.description: Dayan Daniel Kada's summer 2023 series on the great Sepharadi poskim of the twentieth century: Rav Uziel, Rav Yoseph Messas and Rav Haim David HaLevi.
channel.itunes:author: Dayan Daniel Kada

item.title: Rav Uziel: The Chief Rabbi Who Would Not Stand Aside | Our Hakhamim
item.description:
Who was Rav Bension Meir Hai Uziel, the first Sefaradi Chief Rabbi of the State of Israel? A great posek, thinker and communal leader who looked outward to all Israel and humanity, and ruled boldly on autopsies, conversion and women in public life, always within halacha.
Notes based on the transcript - https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SW2D34aJq5Sboxr0_FMjKfEzUEbDknCk7AAU1tLalJw/edit?usp=sharing

item.title: Rav Yoseph Messas: Somersaults in Halacha for the Sake of Love | Our Hakhamim
item.description:
Rav Yoseph Messas of Meknes, Tlemcen and Haifa was a great posek of remarkable self-confidence. The class looks at his rulings on Shabbat-breaking butchers, carrying, hair covering and wine of non-Jews, Rav Ovadia Yoseph's strong disagreement, and his love for every Jew.

item.title: Rav Haim David HaLevi: A Gentle Posek for Changing Times | Our Hakhamim
item.description:
Rav Haim David HaLevi, from a hazan's son to Chief Rabbi of Rishon LeSion and Tel Aviv. His link to Rav Uziel, where they differed, his responsa on lost property, childbirth, fragrance, women's learning and eclipses, and his care for every person.
